parameters.jsCode: const r=$json; for(const k of ['source_code','folder_id','senders','subjects','window_start','window_end']) if(r[k]===undefined||r[k]===null||r[k]==='') throw new Error(`Missing ${k}`); if(!Array.isArray(r.senders)||!r.senders.length||!Array.isArray(r.subjects)||!r.subjects.length) throw new Error('Sender and subject allowlists are required'); const start=new Date(r.window_start), end=new Date(r.window_end); if(!(start<end)||end-start>7*86400000) throw new Error('Sweep window must be positive and at most seven days'); return [{json:{...r,senders:r.senders.map(v=>String(v).toLowerCase()),subjects:r.subjects.map(String)}}];

const c=$('Validate Bounded Mail Contract').first().json; const start=new Date(c.window_start), end=new Date(c.window_end); return $input.all().filter(i=>{const j=i.json; const sender=String(j.from?.emailAddress?.address||j.sender?.emailAddress?.address||'').toLowerCase(); const received=new Date(j.receivedDateTime); return c.senders.includes(sender)&&c.subjects.includes(String(j.subject||''))&&received>=start&&received<end;}).map(i=>({json:{...i.json,source_code:c.source_code,window_start:c.window_start,window_end:c.window_end,run_upper_bound:c.run_upper_bound||c.window_end}}));
